facts.rationale: Preserves exact guards and team coverage without asserting a valid cross-file return contract.
facts.value: Initialization clears capture flags and, for No Contest, sets every copied player standing and each referenced team standing to tier 1. Reveal displaces occupied nonzero-tier objects and conditionally sets x0_6. After successful camera activation, nonzero tiers follow immediate capture; tier zero requires the caller's ftLib_800876B4(...) == 0 test, a clear per-player flag and x0_6 before capturing and latching once. The intended animation-completion interpretation is qualified by a cross-file signature mismatch: this unit declares a signed return, while ftlib defines a void wrapper without a return statement.
